newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia 1997 cocoa output seen 330,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia 1997 cocoa output seen 330,000 tonnes.

text.p: Indonesia's cocoa production is expected to rise to 330,000 tonnes in 1997 from 300,000-310,000 tonnes this year, Litha Brent, chairman of the Indonesia Cocoa Association (ICA) said on Monday.
He told Reuters exports were expected to increase to 260,000 tonnes in 1997 from an estimated 230,000-240,000 tonnes this year.
Brent said the expected increase in production next year would come from an expansion in the area planted with the crop, but did not have details.
The ICA estimates that 460,000 hectares (1.1 million acres) are planted with cocoa, while the government's estimate is 600,000 hectares (1.5 million acres).

Brent said pod borer pest was still considered a problem in some growing regions, but added that the ICA and the American Cocoa Research Institute were jointly involved in a project to contain and control the pest.
